## Context

Neo applications need to find one public workspace/mount root, then resolve applications, Main, workers, themes, resources, and package assets beneath or relative to it. Current configuration exposes `basePath`, `appPath`, `mainPath`, and `workerBasePath`, but merged source uses five different anchors to interpret them.

The latest deployment evidence resolves an earlier false dichotomy in this body: the application mount and public workspace root **coincide by construction** in the measured deployment because the whole workspace is served at `<mount>/`. The direct `/apps/<app>/` route is a development convenience where they diverge. The defect is therefore not yet proven to require a second configurable root. The open fork is whether to formalize and normalize existing `basePath`, add a distinct workspace URL, retain owner-relative paths, use explicit per-surface URLs, or generate a manifest.

Evidence was gathered on merged `dev` at `df05ec3854` from source, build output, historical issues, and peer-trusted physical-consumer traces. The consumer identity is private; only redacted topology and URLs appear here.

## Five Measured Resolution Families

| Surface | Current derivation | Source coordinate | Observed result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Source-mode theme CSS | document URL after `basePath.substring(6)` plus `../../dist/<environment>/` | `src/main/addon/Stylesheet.mjs:72-89`, `:99-105` | direct route requests `/apps/dist/development/css/**`; mounted route happens to request `/dist/development/css/**` |
| Worker entries | `workerBasePath + fileName` from page config | `src/worker/Manager.mjs:236-243` | works when config already carries the mount-aware worker URL |
| Application entry | App-worker module URL plus hard-coded `../../${appPath}` | `src/worker/App.mjs:378-388` | external generators compensate with parent segments tied to package depth |
| Main entry | `MicroLoader.mjs` module URL plus free-form `mainPath` | `src/MicroLoader.mjs:1-4`; appworker generator `:73-78` | copied loader at `<mount>/src/` plus baked `../main.js` requests `<mount>/main.js`, losing `dist/development/` |
| Bundled theme CSS | document URL after deleting six characters from `basePath` | `Stylesheet.mjs:52-55`, `:77-78`, `:103-105` | absolute mount is truncated into a tail such as `udio/`; Font Awesome and five global sheets 404, leaving a live App worker behind a black page |

The fifth specimen proves the severity boundary: bundled Main and all three core workers load from the dist tree, then stylesheet loading alone prevents the shell from mounting.

## Source-of-Authority Conflict

- `learn/guides/advanced/BuildArchitecture.md` defines `basePath` as the physical depth from an application folder back to project root and shows it changing after relocation into `dist/<environment>/`.
- `src/DefaultConfig.mjs` documents `basePath` as the path to the Neo.mjs directory, which is not the same thing for an installed consumer.
- Dist appworker configs generate `basePath`, `mainPath`, and `workerBasePath` independently from output depth.
- `src/MicroLoader.mjs` imports `mainPath` relative to its own module URL; source and copied consumer loaders can therefore give the same config different meaning.

This conflict is why the previous body's proposed `workspaceBasePath` is withdrawn rather than implemented.

## Provisional Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Current Authority | Unresolved Contract Fork | Graduation Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.config.basePath` | `DefaultConfig`; app configs; build generators | formalize as public workspace root vs. preserve legacy/package meaning behind a new workspace URL | compatibility census + exact URL matrix |
| `Neo.config.appPath` | App worker; app generators | workspace-root logical identity vs. worker-relative path/absolute override | native + bundled app load at shallow/nested depths |
| `Neo.config.mainPath` / `MicroLoader` | loader module URL; build generators | workspace-root logical identity vs. explicitly loader-relative path | copied/source loader matrix; red control dropping environment segment |
| `Neo.config.workerBasePath` | Main-thread Worker creation | derived workspace path vs. explicit per-realm override | worker URLs in dedicated/shared modes |
| theme/resource URLs | `Stylesheet`; `createStyleSheet`; environment branches | root + environment asset identity vs. generated manifest/per-surface URL | global/class/Font Awesome 200s in all environments |
| app/dist generators | app creation + appworker webpack configs | emit invariant logical identities vs. environment-relative physical paths | generated-config read-back tests |
| `dist/esm` config generation | `buildScripts/build/esmodules.mjs#minifyFile` | preserve absolute `basePath` without parent-prefixing; derive `workerBasePath` for the ESM output tree rather than the source mount | physical generated-config read-back + worker URL requests (`DC_kwDODSospM4BFeP2`) |
| `dist/esm` installed-package import transform | `buildScripts/build/esmodules.mjs#regexImport`; app scaffold output | rewrite installed-package specifiers for every emitted quote form, or replace regex ownership with an AST transform; no compatibility `dist/esm/node_modules` tree | scaffold single-quote control reaches `/dist/esm/node_modules/neo.mjs/**` 404 only after config isolation (`DC_kwDODSospM4BFeP2`) |

## Newly Measured ESM Prerequisites — Owned Here, Still Provisional

The physical four-environment fixture in D#17886 found two independent `dist/esm` build-output defects at `dev@f1d3ed2840`:

1. An absolute source `basePath: '/mount/'` becomes `../..//mount/`, while generated `workerBasePath` becomes `/mount/src/worker/` and drops the `dist/esm` output segment. Main loads, but App/Data/VDom worker URLs 404.
2. After a served-config-only isolation fixes those URLs, scaffolded single-quoted imports still point at `../../../node_modules/neo.mjs/src/**`. The ESM build flattens Engine modules to `dist/esm/src/**`, but `regexImport` matches only double quotes/backticks, so the first View dependency 404s beneath `dist/esm/node_modules/neo.mjs/**`.

These are prerequisites of this ticket’s all-environment URL contract, not separate shadow work and not gate-6 path-derivation controls. They remain provisional until D#17886 graduates and the ADR + full Contract Ledger are rewritten together. The positive fixture must repair them; compatibility symlinks would invalidate the evidence.

Evidence: [`DC_kwDODSospM4BFeP2`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/17886#discussioncomment-18211830); peer separation/custody audit [`DC_kwDODSospM4BFeQF`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/17886#discussioncomment-18211845).

- Data/Canvas/Task bundle reach; that architecture continues in D#1881.
- Changing Webpack `publicPath: 'auto'` without a graduated option requiring it.
- Consumer-local loader patches before the Engine contract settles.
